title: Paloma and the Letters
author: L. M. Ashgrove
blurb: Coral Brightwater, a pastry chef whose café is three missed payments from gone, swears the heart is a muscle like any other: trainable, containable. Then the anonymous pen-pal assignment pairs enemies instead of strangers — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must let someone stay after the last train leaves before the bakery lease runs out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
